brief.headline: Zaporizhzhia villages fall as Ukraine drone barrage kills infant
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels celebrated the reported capture of Rovnoe, Lesnoe and Malinovka on the Hulyaipole axis while amplifying grief and outrage over a mass Ukrainian drone attack that they say killed a six-month-old in Egorievsk. Sentiment split evenly, with sharp negative swings on Ukrainian strikes and Western rearmament.

developments.title: Channels claim capture of Rovnoe, Lesnoe, Malinovka in Zaporizhzhia
developments.body: At least six channels reported Russian Eastern Forces seized Rovnoe, Lesnoe and Malinovka across the Zaporizhzhia/Donetsk border, with claims of a breakthrough near Vozdvizhenka. Poddubny and Arkhangel Spetsnaza also cite gains near Pokrovsk including Novoselkovka. Unconfirmed and not independently verified.

developments.title: Mass Ukrainian drone attack; infant reported killed in Egorievsk
developments.body: Channels report Ukraine launched 590 drones, with 419 intercepted across ten regions and 50-60 over the Moscow area. Multiple channels emphasise a six-month-old child killed and mother mortally wounded in Egorievsk. Figures are MoD-aligned/unconfirmed; the child's death drove heavy negative sentiment.

developments.title: Continued campaign against Ukrainian fuel and power infrastructure
developments.body: Channels claim Geran/Geranium drones and Su-34 strikes destroyed 25 gas stations and fuel depots and hit 154 kV power lines near Zaporizhzhia, disabling metal plants and defence manufacturers. Rybar tempers claims, saying only 23% of Kharkiv fuel infrastructure has been targeted. Unconfirmed.

developments.title: Sharp negative turn on Western rearmament and NATO in Estonia
developments.body: Channels flagged EU's 3.9bn euro first tranche for Ukrainian drones (of a 90bn package), a new Germany-Netherlands NATO command center in Estonia, Netherlands' 27bn euro budget/100k army plan, Romania's 2bn euro Spyder buy and Lithuania's proposal to lift its ban on foreign bases and nukes. Framed as a Western strategy to destroy Russia.

developments.title: NgP raZVedka pushes Crimea amphibious landing narrative
developments.body: NgP raZVedka claims Ukraine has long planned an amphibious landing near Yalta, exploiting Russian restraint over striking civilian areas. Single-source, unverified — appears aimed at justifying looser targeting rules in Crimea.

developments.title: Long-range air kill and NgP claim of Kyiv offensive prep
developments.body: Kotsnews touts a Su-35 downing a MiG-29 at 190km with an R-37M as a record shot. Separately, NgP raZVedka claims the General Staff ordered preparation for an offensive on Kyiv via Chernihiv — an unverified single-source claim worth watching for escalation signalling.

narrative_watch.title: West arming Ukraine 'to destroy Russia'
narrative_watch.body: EU drone funding and NATO's Estonia command center are framed as an existential Western project against Russia rather than defensive measures, driving a 40-point negative swing.

narrative_watch.title: Crimea landing pretext
narrative_watch.body: Claims of an imminent Ukrainian amphibious landing near Yalta appear designed to justify loosening Russian restraint on strikes in populated areas.

narrative_watch.title: Civilian victimhood in border regions
narrative_watch.body: The Egorievsk infant's death and Shebekino/Belgorod drone attacks are amplified to frame Russia as defending civilians against terror.

mood_lines.text: Buoyant; channels claim multiple settlement captures in Zaporizhzhia and near Pokrovsk, plus a record long-range air kill.
Uniformly upbeat on fuel and power infrastructure strikes, though Rybar notes limited progress in Kharkiv.
Sharp negative swing (net -71, down 38) over 590-drone barrage and reported infant death in Egorievsk.
Sharply negative (net -70, down 40) on EU drone funding, Estonia command center and European rearmament.
Mixed; pride in Belgorod civilian resilience offset by Crimea fuel shortages and closed western border crossings.
Uniformly negative; jabs at Russian self-consciousness, Ukrainian forced conscription, and the Monaco Ermolayev bombing case.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine strikes on Russia dives to -71
flag_texts.body: Sentiment fell 38 points as channels amplified a 590-drone attack and the reported killing of a six-month-old in Egorievsk, dominating the day's negative coverage.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO drops to -70
flag_texts.body: A 40-point negative swing driven by EU's 3.9bn euro drone tranche, a new Germany-Netherlands NATO command center in Estonia, and European rearmament announcements framed as anti-Russian escalation.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours and Putin criticism absent
flag_texts.body: Watchlist items 'Mobilisation rumours' and 'Criticism of Putin' saw no posts; criticism instead targeted government perception management, Ukrainian conscription and the Monaco bombing case.
